# Security policy

This repository is an experimental research artifact. Only the current `main`
revision is considered for fixes; there are no supported stable releases yet.

Report exploitable software vulnerabilities through
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/thequantumfalcon/bounded-count-identifiability/security/advisories/new).
Include the affected revision, minimal reproducer, impact and tested environment.
Do not post credentials or sensitive data in public issues.

Tool-generated reports need a reproducible, verified example. An untested scanner
claim alone is insufficient. The maintainer will assess reports but promises no
response-time agreement. No bounty is offered.

A mathematical counterexample or numerical discrepancy usually belongs in the
public mathematical-correction issue form unless it also exposes a software
security vulnerability. Formal proof checking does not audit arbitrary programs,
downloaded dependencies or a user's operating environment.
